overall: Read the exact spoken text as one continuous conversational passage to one listener. Use a slightly dry, informed delivery with natural sentence breaths, clean connections and clear changes in energy. Let curiosity become precise discovery, then settle into the conditional consequence and proposal limit. The draft and approval line is the quietest, fully articulated point; the retained-pod answer closes lower and certain. Speak only the fenced script. Do not perform instruction words, add speech, or force the read to a preset duration.
performance_arc: Curious entry, precise control and operator condition, calm consequence and bounded proposal.
sound_execution: The mixer executes the target-quiet background reduction on s5-event-2 and the designed winch cue on s8-event-3. Continue the narration naturally through those events; narration is never muted, spliced or time stretched.

lines.text: The pod can come back up.
lines.intent: Invite curiosity about the unexpected return, as a direct observation to one listener.
lines.energy: Begin with a small curious lift; light conversational energy and a settled last word.
lines.pause_after: Natural full-stop breath; carry attention into the explanation.
lines.risk: Do not turn the opening into a teaser or claim an observed customer delivery.

lines.text: Zipline's delivery pod lowers on a tether.
lines.intent: Establish the tethered descent as the physical action behind the opening.
lines.energy: Settle slightly below the hook, with steady clarity and no announcement cadence.
lines.pause_after: Ordinary breath into the next connected action.
lines.risk: Say Zipline as ZIP-line; keep the possessive connected to delivery pod.

lines.text: The pod evaluates the drop area and can move sideways.
lines.intent: Reveal the sideways control while keeping the target evaluation easy to follow.
lines.energy: Lift slightly above the descent line as a useful discovery; keep the first clause fluid.
lines.pause_after: Ordinary sentence boundary, without a held gap.
lines.risk: Evaluation is the described function; do not imply a demonstrated success rate.

lines.text: If it can't identify and evaluate the target, an image goes to an operator.
lines.intent: Carry the unresolved target condition cleanly into the operator handoff.
lines.energy: Hold the discovery energy through the condition, then lower slightly on the human handoff.
lines.pause_after: Normal breath after the complete conditional sentence.
lines.risk: Long conditional: preserve every word and causal link, without a dramatic mid-sentence break.

lines.text: If the spot is unsuitable, the pod retracts.
lines.intent: Land the failed-target consequence while the package stays retained.
lines.energy: Drop clearly below the handoff line; concise and certain, leaving the action to the picture.
lines.pause_after: Brief natural full-stop breath into the source limit.
lines.risk: Retraction is conditional; avoid a triumphant lift or suggesting a completed drop.

lines.text: This is a draft. The proposed expansion still needs FAA approval.
lines.intent: Make the draft status and required approval unmistakable in the quietest delivery.
lines.energy: Lowest energy in the passage, below the retraction line; clear and level, never whispered.
lines.pause_after: Ordinary breath between the two sentences and at the end; no held silence.
lines.risk: Say FAA as F A A. Preserve draft and proposed expansion; the second sentence must stay fully audible.

lines.text: An FAA draft proposes expanded deliveries around Austin and other Texas cities. Comments are open through October eleventh.
lines.intent: Locate the proposed expansion and give the public-comment deadline as practical information.
lines.energy: Recover modestly above the quiet limit, still restrained; keep both sentences connected and conversational.
lines.pause_after: Normal sentence boundary before the deadline, then a natural breath into the closing answer.
lines.risk: Longest scene: say FAA as F A A and eleventh clearly. Let measured narration set timing; never hurry or stretch to fit the preview.

lines.text: A package descending is only half the story. The check can pull the pod back up.
lines.intent: Resolve the opening through the returning pod, with the package still retained.
lines.energy: Ease below the deadline line to a calm conclusion; give the first sentence a small turn, then land the answer lower and certain.
lines.pause_after: Natural final release; the picture and credits supply the ending hold.
lines.risk: Keep the check as the cause of return. Avoid a trailer flourish, cheerful delivery payoff or implied approved expansion.
